# Wisnu Alfian Nur Ashar - Full-Stack Developer & Cybersecurity Specialist

## About

Full-Stack Developer & Cybersecurity Specialist based in Bekasi, Indonesia. 8+ years of professional experience building production applications with expertise in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, Golang, and cloud infrastructure.

- **Enterprise-Grade Applications** including ERP/POS platforms, AI-powered systems, e-commerce platforms, and cybersecurity tools
